title: One Point, One Benched Tight End, and One Very Long Night for Kai
dek: Sonny's Horse survives Mekhi by a single point while Brock Bowers watches from the Dawgs bench, Randy actually makes a trade, and the league now has three unbeaten teams staring down Buckaroo Bowl IV.
body: The Horse is Hea beat Dawgs 122.7 to 121.7 in Week 3, and if you want to know where that one point went, check the Dawgs bench. Brock Bowers was sitting there with 22.6 points, more than double his 11.15 projection, while Justin Jefferson posted 4.2 in the starting lineup on a 14.79 projection. Mekhi, a man who probably knows more football than anyone in this league, lost by the margin of a rounding error with the answer key in his pocket. It is the most Kai loss imaginable, and the Dawgs fall to 0-3 despite 320.8 points for, more than two teams with winning records.

The cruelest part is that the waiver-wire king did his job. Mekhi grabbed Tyler Shough off the wire, dropping Jameson Williams, and Shough delivered 23.8 points as one of the week's top performers. On the other side, Sonny rode Jaxon Smith-Njigba to 30.36 points on a 17.19 projection and escaped as a 65 percent favorite who needed every decimal. The commish is now 3-0, his title odds doubled from 10 percent to 20, and somewhere a Boston sports radio caller is already declaring him a dynasty.

Meanwhile, alert the authorities, Randy made a trade. The fumblers sent Javonte Williams to Team Pillbert for Stefon Diggs, which means the league's most famously stingy manager not only traded, but traded with the league villain. Randy then went out and beat Zoe 91.64 to 86.64 as a 69 percent favorite, even with Jonathan Taylor laying an 8.2 on a 19.1 projection. Three weeks, three wins, and one completed transaction; Randy's still got 15 percent title odds, down from 20, so expect complaints regardless.

Zilgit deserved better. Bijan Robinson went off for 34.3 points, nearly doubling his 17.31 projection, and Ghostu-Spider SZN still came up five points short. The rookie was busy on the wire too, swapping Brian Thomas Jr. for Josh Downs, Jonathon Brooks for Blake Corum, and Cairo Santos for kicker Trey Smack. She sits at 1-2 with 10 percent playoff odds, which is about as warm as a Green Bay December, but nobody in this league is tinkering harder in Year One.

Philliberto did villain things. Team Pillbert beat Counting or not Counting GV 117.88 to 100.98 behind Jahmyr Gibbs, who torched JMoney for 37.9 points, the best performance of the week, and Brock Purdy's 31.28. The bad guy even won with a handicap: De'Von Achane gave him 1.7 points on a 17.27 projection, and Harold Fannin Jr. scored 20.6 on his bench. Alan also dropped Jaxson Dart and Lions D/ST to add Bryce Young and Denzel Boston, because apparently two quarterbacks are a lifestyle. Jordan, for the numbers guy, the numbers are grim: 0-3 and a league-low 259 points for.

And then there's Brucie. No Banner only HULK hung 134.46 on Habibsters, leaving Kaushal's 100.74 in the dust, and did it with Matthew Stafford's 20.9 points sitting on the bench. Ramon is 3-0 with 444.2 points for, more than 70 clear of anyone else, 100 percent playoff odds, and 54 percent title odds. He also swapped Chuba Hubbard for Rashee Rice in a deal with Sonny, so the commissioner is now helping arm the guy everyone wants to see lose. Habib, the two-time champ, got 23.9 from Drake London and reloaded with Sam LaPorta, Deebo Samuel Sr., and 49ers D/ST, but he's 0-3 and the luck has been slower than his Georgia driving.

The standings: Ramon, Sonny, and Randy are all 3-0, with Alan lurking at 2-1 and 77 percent playoff odds. Zoe is 1-2, and then it's a three-way 0-3 traffic jam of Mekhi, Kaushal, and Jordan. Sonny's 20 percent title odds are the biggest riser of the week; Randy and Alan both slipped despite winning, which tells you how much shadow the HULK casts.

Next week is a gift. Team Pillbert vs No Banner only HULK is villain vs villain, Philly vs Brucie, and the rest of the league has to figure out who to root against harder. Dawgs vs Counting or not Counting GV guarantees one 0-3 team finally wins, The fumblers try to stay perfect against a reloaded Habibsters, and Zoe gets a shot at knocking the commissioner off his unbeaten horse.

social.author: Bench Points Anonymous
social.text: Brock Bowers: 22.6 points on the bench. Margin of defeat: 1.0. Kai, we have a support group. Meetings are Tuesdays. Bring your lineup regrets.

social.author: The Buckaroo Insider
social.text: BREAKING: Sources confirm Randy has completed a trade. Officials are reviewing the footage. Stefon Diggs heads to The fumblers, Javonte Williams to Pillbert. More as this impossible story develops.

social.author: Horse is Hea Faithful
social.text: 3-0. Won by a point. JSN with 30. Title odds doubled. Worst to first to worst-nightmare-for-everyone-else. Wicked good week, commish.

social.author: Anti-Brucie Coalition
social.text: 134 points with Stafford on the BENCH. 444 total through three weeks. We are begging someone, anyone, to beat this man. Philly, it pains us, but you're our only hope next week.

social.author: Cheesehead Fantasy Desk
social.text: Bijan drops 34.3 and Zilgit still loses by five. Rookie made three waiver moves this week. She is learning the league faster than the league is learning to deal with her.

social.author: Pillbert Villain Fan Club
social.text: Gibbs 37.9. Purdy 31.28. Achane gave us 1.7 and we STILL won by 17. The bad guys are 2-1 and heading straight for the HULK. Boo us louder.

social.author: Habib Hotline
social.text: Added LaPorta, Deebo, and the 49ers D/ST. Two Buckaroo Bowl rings say this 0-3 start is just Habib warming up. He's always been fast; he's just due for some luck.

social.author: The Numbers Guy Podcast
social.text: JMoney stat corner: 259 points for, lowest in the league. Good news: next week vs Dawgs, one of you is getting off the schneid. Bad news: Kai just added Shough and he scored 23.8.

social.author: Bears Misery Index
social.text: Randy is 3-0 with Jonathan Taylor scoring 8.2. Imagine how loud the complaining would be if he'd actually lost.

bios.1: The defending champ is 3-0 after surviving Mekhi by exactly one point, with JSN carrying the load. His title odds doubled to 20 percent, and he added Chuba Hubbard and the Eagles D/ST this week. The worst-to-first story keeps writing itself.
bios.2: Randy is 3-0 and, stunningly, made a trade, bringing in Stefon Diggs for Javonte Williams. He beat Zoe despite Jonathan Taylor's dud, though his title odds slipped to 15 percent. Unbeaten, and surely still finding something to complain about.
bios.3: JMoney is 0-3 with a league-low 259 points for and just 1 percent playoff odds after Gibbs ran wild on him. He added Tank Bigsby and the Patriots D/ST looking for answers. Next week against fellow winless Dawgs, somebody finally gets a W.
bios.4: The villain is 2-1 after Gibbs and Purdy steamrolled Jordan, even with Achane laying an egg. Alan reshuffled with Bryce Young, Denzel Boston, and Javonte Williams, and sits at 77 percent playoff odds. Next up is the HULK, in the league's ultimate who-do-we-root-against game.
bios.5: Kai is 0-3 despite 320.8 points for, and lost this week by one point with Brock Bowers' 22.6 on the bench. His waiver pickup Tyler Shough was a hit, which somehow makes it hurt more. A date with winless Jordan offers a way off the schneid.
bios.6: The two-time champion is 0-3 after getting run over by the HULK, with Drake London the lone bright spot. Habib reloaded with Sam LaPorta, Deebo Samuel Sr., and the 49ers D/ST. The luck has to turn eventually, and Randy's unbeaten fumblers are next.
bios.7: Brucie's juggernaut is 3-0 with a ridiculous 444.2 points for, 100 percent playoff odds, and 54 percent title odds. He left 20.9 from Stafford on the bench and still won by 34, then added Rashee Rice via trade with Sonny. Everyone is rooting against him, and so far it isn't working.
bios.8: Zilgit is 1-2 after a five-point loss that wasted a 34.3-point Bijan explosion. The rookie made three waiver moves, adding Josh Downs, Blake Corum, and Trey Smack, and has 10 percent playoff odds. Next week she gets a shot at the unbeaten commish.
